# Data dictionary (generated from the SQLAlchemy models, 2026-10-26)

*Generated by reading `Base.metadata` from `workbench/api/dermpath` (core, ML and ML-engine models; schema version 2, 42 tables). Regenerate after a schema change. Patients appear only as coded identifiers: no column is designed to hold a patient name, MRN or birth date. The `name` columns are dataset, project, feature-set and run names, and `user_account.display_name` is a staff name. **Exception to watch:** `slide.original_filename` and `upload.original_filename` keep the uploaded or imported file's name as metadata, and a real file name can contain an identifier. The workbench flags name- and date-like patterns as a possible identifier source, but de-identification must happen before upload (`data-governance.md`). Controlled values are listed at the end; public datasets are described in `public-datasets.md`.*

# Core: organisation, hierarchy, slides, QC, annotations, labels, datasets, jobs, audit (`dermpath/models.py`)

## `annotation_version`

One immutable version of an annotation. Geometry is in LEVEL-0 PIXEL coordinates (x to the right, y downwards, origin at the top-left of level 0).

| Column | Type | Null | Key / reference | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | PK |  |
| `annotation_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no |  |  |
| `version` | INTEGER | no |  |  |
| `project_id` | VARCHAR(64) | no | → project.id |  |
| `slide_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | → slide.id |  |
| `geometry_type` | VARCHAR(16) | no |  |  |
| `geometry_json` | JSON | no |  |  |
| `transform_meta_json` | JSON | no |  |  |
| `label` | VARCHAR(100) | yes |  |  |
| `comment` | TEXT | yes |  |  |

| `superseded_by` | VARCHAR(32) | yes |  |  |
| `deleted` | BOOLEAN | no |  |  |

Unique together: (annotation_id,version)

## `dataset_item`

One included slide. Lineage and slide metadata are SNAPSHOTS taken at materialise time (design §2): manifests and split allocation read these columns, never the live hierarchy, so a slide moved or re-described after materialise cannot silently change a version (freeze re-materialises and refuses a stale draft).

| Column | Type | Null | Key / reference | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | PK |  |
| `dataset_version_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | → dataset_version.id |  |
| `slide_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | → slide.id |  |
| `slide_sha256` | VARCHAR(64) | no |  |  |
| `label_version_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | → label_version.id |  |
| `label_value` | VARCHAR(40) | no |  |  |
| `label_scope` | VARCHAR(16) | no |  |  |
| `case_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | → case_record.id |  |
| `coded_patient_id` | VARCHAR(32) | no | → coded_patient.id |  |
| `patient_code` | VARCHAR(32) | yes |  |  |
| `accession_code` | VARCHAR(40) | yes |  |  |
| `part` | VARCHAR(4) | yes |  |  |
| `block_id` | VARCHAR(32) | yes |  |  |
| `block` | VARCHAR(8) | yes |  |  |
| `level_index` | INTEGER | yes |  |  |

# Controlled values (`dermpath/vocab.py`, `dermpath/ml/engine_models.py`)

## Provenance

| Value | Data mode | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `demo_synthetic` | synthetic | DEMO SYNTHETIC (procedural tiles, not histology) |
| `public_cc0` | real | PUBLIC CC0 (OpenSlide test data, unlabeled) |
| `public_licensed` | real | PUBLIC LICENSED DATASET (third-party research data; licence terms recorded with the project, e.g. non-commercial) |
| `real_authorized` | real | REAL DATA (authorized; attestation recorded, not proof of de-identification) |

A dataset's `data_mode` is `synthetic` when every item is `demo_synthetic` + `synthetic_tiles`, `real` when every item has a real provenance, and `mixed` otherwise (refused at freeze).

## Label sources (`label_version.source`)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `expert` | Expert label recorded by a pathologist in this workbench |
| `model_suggestion` | Model suggestion (not expert truth) |
| `imported_reference` | Imported reference label from an external dataset's reference standard (not an expert read in this workbench) |

## Reference standards (`dataset_version.config_json.reference_standard`)

| Value | Accepted label sources | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `expert` | `expert` | Expert reference: adjudicated, agreed or single-reader expert labels recorded in this workbench |
| `imported_reference` | `imported_reference` | Imported reference: labels from an external dataset's own reference standard (see each label's provenance); not expert reads in this workbench |

Default: `expert`. Configs written before the key existed are expert-reference. `dermpath.labels.label_source_permitted(source, reference_standard)` is the single rule.

## Label values

| Value | Display |
|---|---|
| `bcc_present` | BCC present |
| `bcc_absent_not_benign` | BCC absent (may include other malignancy, inflammation or mimics). BCC absent is NOT the same as benign. |
| `indeterminate` | Indeterminate |
| `inadequate` | Inadequate for assessment |
| `out_of_scope` | Out of scope for this research task |

## Review states

`imported` · `pending_review` · `approved` · `disputed` · `excluded`

Dataset-eligible review states: `approved` · `pending_review` · `imported`; `imported` (never reviewed in the workbench) only in a dataset whose reference standard is `imported_reference`.

## Other vocabularies

* Label scopes: `case` · `slide` · `region`; dataset label scopes: `slide` · `case`
* Image kinds: `wsi` · `field_image` · `synthetic_tiles`; ingest statuses: `pending` · `running` · `succeeded` · `failed`
* Suggestion origins: `demo_fixture` · `model`
* Splits: `train` · `val` · `test`; partitions: `random` · `temporal` · `external_site`
